meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
India mein acne-prone (pimples wali) skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar kai acche aur effective options available hain. Aapki skin ki zaroorat ke hisaab se kuch best serums yeh hain:

### 1. Agar aapko active acne, whiteheads ya blackheads ki problem hai:

* **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/serums-with-salicylic-acid/c/20703?sort=popularity&transaction_id=e751102e765762850547e6f6c7241353#:~:text=Minimalist%202%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Face%20Serum%20For,Enjoy%20Complimentary%20Gift.%20%284218%29.%20Add%20to%20Bag.)**

* **The Derma Co 2% Salicylic Acid Serum[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/serums-with-salicylic-acid/c/20703?sort=popularity&transaction_id=e751102e765762850547e6f6c7241353#:~:text=The%20Derma%20Co%202%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Serum,2%20Sizes.%20%E2%82%B9599%E2%82%B952712%25%20Off.%20Enjoy%20Complimentary%20Gift.)**
  *   * **Price:[www.brillare.co.in](https://www.brillare.co.in/products/salicylic-acid-face-serum-for-oily-acne-prone-skin#:~:text=2%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Face%20Serum%20for%20Acne-Prone,2%25%20Zinc.%20Reduces%20swelling%2C%20prevents%20acne%20formation.)** ₹400 - ₹500 ke beech mein (discounts ke saath aur sasta mil jata hai)
  * **Kyu kharidein:** Isme Witch Hazel aur Willow Bark bhi hota hai jo acne ki redness aur inflammation ko kam karta hai.

### 2. Agar aapko acne ke daag (marks) aur oily skin ki problem hai:

* **The Derma Co 10% Niacinamide Face Serum (with 2% Zinc PCA)[www.drsheths.com](https://www.drsheths.com/blogs/news/affordable-niacinamide-serums-under-800-for-daily-use#:~:text=Based%20on%20clinical%20efficacy%2C%20formulation%20elegance%2C%20and,For%3A%20Oily%2C%20combination%2C%20and%20acne-prone%20skin%20types.)**
  *   * **Price:[www.brillare.co.in](https://www.brillare.co.in/products/salicylic-acid-face-serum-for-oily-acne-prone-skin#:~:text=2%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Face%20Serum%20for%20Acne-Prone,2%25%20Zinc.%20Reduces%20swelling%2C%20prevents%20acne%20formation.)** Approx.[www.drsheths.com](https://www.drsheths.com/blogs/news/affordable-niacinamide-serums-under-800-for-daily-use#:~:text=Based%20on%20clinical%20efficacy%2C%20formulation%20elegance%2C%20and,For%3A%20Oily%2C%20combination%2C%20and%20acne-prone%20skin%20types.) ₹399 - ₹600 (offers mein aur kam hota hai)
  * **Kyu kharidein:** Niacinamide skin ke oil production ko control karta hai aur Zinc PCA acne-causing bacteria se ladta hai.[www.brillare.co.in](https://www.brillare.co.in/products/salicylic-acid-face-serum-for-oily-acne-prone-skin#:~:text=in%20other%20words%2C%20just%20like%20hammer%2C%20it,attacks%20acne%20causing%20bacteria%20from%20two%20sides.) Yeh pimples ke purane daag aur marks ko fade karne mein bahut madad karta hai.
* **Minimalist 10% Niacinamide Face Serum[beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/products/salicylic-acid-2#:~:text=*%20Show%20more.%20*%20Salicylic%20Acid%20%2B,Hydrating%20Factors%207.3%25%20Hair%20Shampoo.%20*%20Account.)**
  *   * **Price:[www.brillare.co.in](https://www.brillare.co.in/products/salicylic-acid-face-serum-for-oily-acne-prone-skin#:~:text=2%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Face%20Serum%20for%20Acne-Prone,2%25%20Zinc.%20Reduces%20swelling%2C%20prevents%20acne%20formation.)** Approx.[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/serums-with-salicylic-acid/c/20703?sort=popularity&transaction_id=e751102e765762850547e6f6c7241353#:~:text=Minimalist%202%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Face%20Serum%20For,Enjoy%20Complimentary%20Gift.%20%284218%29.%20Add%20to%20Bag.) ₹599[beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/products/salicylic-acid-2#:~:text=*%20Show%20more.%20*%20Salicylic%20Acid%20%2B,New%20Launch%3A%20Hydrating%20Factors%207.3%25%20Hair%20Shampoo.)
  * **Kyu kharidein:** Agar aapki skin sensitive hai aur aapko gentle oil control + barrier repair chahiye, toh yeh ek reliable choice hai.

### Kuch zaroori baatein (Tips):

* **Patch Test:[thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/blogs/news/affordable-niacinamide-serums-under-800-for-daily-use-in-india#:~:text=Patch%20test%20new%20formulas%20first%2C%20especially%20if,to%20niacinamide%20paired%20with%20zinc%20PCA%20or)** Koi bhi naya serum use karne se pehle apne haath ya kaan ke peeche patch test zaroor karein taaki pata chale ki woh aapko suit kar raha hai ya nahi.
* **Sunscreen:[www.brillare.co.in](https://www.brillare.co.in/products/salicylic-acid-face-serum-for-oily-acne-prone-skin#:~:text=Skin%20Ritual%20*%20Powder%20Face%20Wash%20%28AM,serum.%20*%20Sunscreen%20%28AM%29%20Apply%20after%20moisturiser.)** Agar aap Salicylic Acid jaisa exfoliating serum use kar rahe hain, toh subah ke waqt ek acchi sunscreen lagana bilkul na bhulein.

Aapki skin par is waqt active pimples zyada hain ya purane daag? Iske baare mein batayenge toh main aapko aur bhi behtar suggest kar sakunga.
